t: This is Carradale House, a building in Tower Hamlets. It was designed by Ernő Goldfinger, the Hungarian-British architect and furniture designer, who lived from 1902 to 1987. That is really all the material I have for this place, so I won't guess at more. If you know Goldfinger's other London work, you can look here for the same hand at work, a block planned by an architect with a strong modernist reputation.
